# vision-structured-extract

> Extract schema-validated JSON from images through an injected vision model port: header-only image checks, a JSON Schema subset and a bounded re-ask loop Python package `trysac-vision-structured-extract`, import name `vision_structured_extract`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
